title: Bas deng Melodi
subject: a married couple in a Tomohon church kolintang group, she on the melody bars at one end of the row and he on the bass box at the other, cueing each other across the hall at Thursday rehearsals
caption: Minahasa kolintang ensemble pop from North Sulawesi, a church-hall wooden xylophone band playing a love song. A melody kolintang carrying the tune in quick tremolo rolls on bright wooden bars; alto and tenor kolintang filling the chords in broken patterns; a cello kolintang walking a counter-line; a big bass kolintang thumping round low notes from its wooden box resonator; a steel-string ukulele strumming the off-beats. Airy community-hall room recording, all wood and mallet attack. Warm female alto vocal, gentle and conversational with a Manado accent, a male baritone joining in harmony on the last chorus. 96 BPM, F major. Tender, teasing and settled. No drum kit, no synth pads, no gamelan, no dangdut groove, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - melody kolintang alone]

[Verse 1]
Tiap Kamis malam di aula gereja
Kita di ujung kiri, pegang kolintang melodi
Ngana di ujung kanan, di belakang peti bas
Dua belas taon so bagini, nyanda pernah tukar tampa

[Pre-Chorus]
Opa Dirk angka tangan, torang mulai
Ngana cuma lia pa kita, nyanda lia not angka

[Chorus]
Kalu kita ketuk dua kali, ngana masuk
Bas deng melodi, dari ujung ka ujung
Orang bilang torang dua jauh skali
Padahal cuma sepuluh langkah deng satu lagu

[Verse 2]
Ngana pe pemukul bas so dibungkus karet baru
Kita pe tangan so ada urat, mar masih cepat
Ngana salah masuk, kong ngana senyum pa kita
Kita pura-pura mara, mar kita ikut senyum

[Bridge - bass and cello kolintang alone]
Satu kali ngana demam, anak SMP ganti ngana
Lagu jalan trus, mar kita salah masuk tiga kali

[Pre-Chorus]
Abis latihan, ngana so kase hidup motor
Singgah beli goroho goreng deng dabu-dabu

[Chorus - with male harmony]
Kalu kita ketuk dua kali, ngana masuk
Bas deng melodi, dari ujung ka ujung
Natal nanti torang main di depan jemaat
Kita mo lia pa ngana, bukan pa Opa Dirk

[Outro - melody kolintang, slowing]
Kita ketuk dua kali
Dari ujung sana, ngana balas
